job.title: Software Technical Lead
job.description:
Software Technical Lead


Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Denver, CO – Hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote within the U.S. for candidates outside the Denver market

Salary Range: $210,000–$235,000


Why This Role Exists

Our client operates a large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platform used daily by businesses and consumers across the United States. The organization is in the midst of a significant platform transformation—breaking a legacy monolith into domain-owned microservices, building a modern event-driven architecture on AWS, and introducing production AI agents capable of taking meaningful action within business workflows.

The Software Technical Lead will serve as the engineering anchor for one or more product or platform areas. This is a senior individual contributor position for someone who can translate architectural decisions into production software, lead design and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and take ownership of systems once they reach production.

This is not a people-management position. You will provide hands-on technical leadership to a small team of engineers, including both U.S.-based and offshore resources, while remaining deeply involved in architecture, coding, reviews, deployment, and production support.


Scope & Scale


You will work across:

  • Multiple product or platform areas supported by small engineering teams.
  • Legacy applications currently in production as well as new services being built or extracted from the monolith.
  • A large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS environment with tenant-specific configurations and feature flags.
  • REST, SOAP, webhook, and event-driven integrations with third-party systems.
  • Production AI agents that interact with your domain and depend upon reliable service and tool contracts.


What You’ll Own


End-to-End Technical Ownership Take technical responsibility for assigned product and platform areas, including both existing production systems and newly developed services.

Service Design & Delivery Lead initiatives from initial design documentation through production rollout and cutover. You’ll help determine service boundaries, identify the appropriate seams for extracting functionality from the monolith, and define how application data transitions into the new architecture.

Full-Stack Application Delivery Lead the delivery of complete vertical slices, including independently deployable React/Next.js frontend modules, API/BFF contracts, domain-owned microservices, event-driven architecture, independent deployment pipelines, and application performance and monitoring.

AI Agent Integration Partner with the AI platform team when production AI agents interact with your domain. You’ll own the supporting tool contracts, including schemas, SLAs, idempotency, evaluation fixtures, and guardrails.

Engineering Velocity & Quality Establish development practices that improve team productivity while maintaining a high engineering quality bar.

Technical Standards & Mentorship Define patterns for cross-team contracts, code reviews, design reviews, incident ownership, and on-call responsibilities while mentoring engineers across the team.

What Success Looks Like


First 90 Days

You will learn the platform, understand the existing monolith and modernization roadmap, and take ownership of your assigned technical areas and their production support responsibilities.

You’ll begin leading design and code reviews, establish engineering expectations with the team, ship a meaningful production change in your primary technology stack, and develop the design plan for an upcoming domain extraction.


First Year

Success will include leading at least one significant domain extraction from the monolith through dual-write, traffic splitting, validation, and clean production cutover.

You’ll help establish independently deployable frontend modules, ensure performance standards are met, implement reliable tool contracts for AI agents interacting with your domain, and create a cohesive delivery cadence across onshore and offshore engineering resources.


Hands-On Expectations


This is a senior individual contributor role, not a management role.

The majority of your time will be spent working directly with technology—writing production code, creating design documentation, reviewing pull requests, leading technical reviews, and owning production cutovers.

You will also be responsible for cross-team technical contracts, production incidents, on-call ownership, and mentoring engineers.


What You Bring


Must Have

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years operating as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or comparable senior technical contributor.
  • Strong proficiency in at least three of the following:
  • Python
  • Java/Spring Boot
  • PHP/Laravel
  • TypeScript/React
  • Ability to write production code in your primary stack while effectively reviewing code across additional technologies.
  • Significant hands-on AWS production experience, ideally including Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, and CloudWatch.
  • Demonstrated experience breaking a production monolith into microservices.
  • Experience defining domain-driven service boundaries and applying modernization patterns such as strangler fig and anti-corruption layers.
  • Experience separating shared databases and leading a meaningful production service extraction involving techniques such as dual-write validation, traffic splitting, canary deployments, or tenant-based rollouts.
  • Full-stack delivery experience, including frontend and backend development within the same product area.
  • Experience owning application performance, observability, and monitoring.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs at scale using REST, SOAP, webhooks, idempotency, retry/backoff patterns, and other integration techniques.
  • Experience working with relational databases such as MySQL/Aurora and NoSQL platforms such as DynamoDB.
  • Strong written technical communication skills, particularly architecture and design documentation.
  • Ability to create reusable technical abstractions without unnecessary complexity.


Strongly Preferred

  • Experience delivering production AI or agentic workflows.
  • Exposure to code-first AI agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, LangGraph, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock/AgentCore, MCP servers, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and AI cost/latency management.
  • Micro-frontend architecture experience, including independently deployable frontend components, module federation

job.description:
Company

American Promotional Events, Inc.-East d/b/a TNT Fireworks

Reports To

Senior Vice President, IT & Operations

Location

Florence, Alabama


The Opportunity


TNT Fireworks is seeking a Vice President of Information Technology to lead the company's technology organization and play a central role in a broader business transformation initiative supporting national retail, wholesale, and distribution operations.


The mandate extends well beyond maintaining existing systems. The VP will evaluate the current technology environment, identify opportunities to simplify and modernize the architecture, and establish a technology roadmap aligned with TNT's long-term growth and operating strategy.


A major near-term priority will be evaluating TNT's core enterprise platform. The company currently operates JD Edwards EnterpriseOne in a stable hybrid environment, but business processes have evolved beyond portions of the existing configuration, creating customizations, manual processes, and workarounds. The VP will work across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other functional leaders to determine whether TNT should optimize and extend its current JDE environment or transition to a new ERP platform, develop the business case and roadmap, and lead execution of the chosen strategy.


The VP will also help define and lead TNT's enterprise approach to artificial intelligence, identifying practical opportunities to improve productivity, decision-making, automation and operating performance while establishing the data foundation, governance and security required for responsible adoption.


The role carries executive responsibility for cybersecurity, infrastructure, enterprise applications, data and reporting, technology vendors, end-user support and business continuity. TNT operates a highly seasonal business whose technology footprint expands significantly during peak periods. The successful executive must modernize technology while protecting business continuity, security, and operating performance during the company's most critical revenue periods.


Key Responsibilities


Technology Strategy & Business Transformation


·  Develop and execute an enterprise technology strategy aligned with TNT's business priorities, growth, and operational requirements.

·  Assess the current technology architecture and establish a practical modernization roadmap.

·  Develop and lead TNT's enterprise AI strategy, identifying practical opportunities to apply AI across the business to improve productivity, decision-making, automation and operational performance.

·  Partner with functional leaders to identify and prioritize AI use cases, establish appropriate governance, and translate emerging capabilities into measurable business value.

·  Lead evaluation and modernization of TNT's core enterprise systems, including the potential optimization, expansion or replacement of the JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environment.

·  Evaluate ERP and broader technology modernization decisions with consideration for data readiness, integration capabilities and TNT's ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies over the long term.

·  Partner with functional leaders to distinguish technology limitations from process, configuration and organizational issues.

·  Build business cases, investment priorities and implementation roadmaps for major technology and AI initiatives.

·  Lead large-scale technology programs from evaluation and selection through implementation, adoption and measurable business impact.


Leadership & Organizational Development

·  Lead and develop three specialized managers spanning software and applications, network/infrastructure/security, and JD Edwards technical administration and end-user support.

·  Build leadership capability and technical depth within the technology organization.

·  Create strong alignment between technology functions that must operate as an integrated team.

·  Build bench strength in critical areas including enterprise applications, JD Edwards technical knowledge, and cybersecurity.

·  Serve as a trusted technology partner to TNT's senior leadership and functional executives.


Cybersecurity & Business Continuity

·  Maintain executive ownership of TNT's cybersecurity posture, risk management and incident preparedness.

·  Drive continuous improvement across identity and access management, endpoint and network protection, vulnerability management, monitoring, backup integrity and security awareness.

·  Maintain effective incident response, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities, including readiness during peak operating periods.

·  Ensure controls support PCI-DSS obligations and applicable privacy and compliance requirements.

·  Address the security challenges created by rapid seasonal expansion, including onboarding and offboarding, field devices, access management and credential hygiene.

·  Communicate technology and cybersecurity risk clearly to executive leadership.


ERP, Enterprise Systems, Infrastructure & Data

·  Lead the cross-functional evaluation of TNT's ERP direction, including requirements definition, fit-gap analysis, platform and partner evaluation, business case development and executive recommendation.

·  Evaluate JD Edwards remediation, upgrade or extension against potential migration to another ERP platform with equal rigor.

·  Own execution of the selected ERP strategy, including governance, implementation partner management, budget, schedule and risk.

·  Ensure reliability, scalability and performance across corporate, distribution and seasonal retail environments.

·  Establish appropriate architecture across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.

·  Improve enterprise data quality, reporting capabilities and access to reliable business information.

·  Maintain disciplined governance around system changes, integrations, customization, QA and technology lifecycle management.


Innovation, AI & Emerging Technology

·  Establish a disciplined enterprise approach to evaluating and adopting AI and other emerging technologies for practical business applications.

·  Partner across functions to identify high-value AI opportunities in areas such as productivity, analytics, workflow automation, decision support and customer or operational processes.

·  Drive adoption through training, experimentation, change management and measurement of actual business value.

·  Develop governance around acceptable use, data handling, security, privacy, model/tool review and ongoing oversight of AI and emerging technologies.

·  Ensure the underlying data environment, integrations, and business processes support responsible and effective AI adoption.

·  Evaluate AI capabilities embedded within existing and prospective enterprise platforms alongside standalone technology solutions.


Seasonal Readiness

·  Own technology readiness for TNT's major seasonal operating peaks.

·  Coordinate capacity planning, connectivity, device provisioning, support staffing, and change management across the technology organization.

·  Build cybersecurity into seasonal readiness through pre-season hardening, in-season monitoring, and post-season access and device controls.

·  Protect critical operating periods from unnecessary technology change while maintaining appropriate security response capability.

·  Lead post-season reviews that produce measurable year-over-year improvement.


Vendor & Financial Management

·  Own key technology vendor and systems integration relationships.

·  Manage technology operating and capital budgets across TNT's seasonal spend pattern.

·  Negotiate major technology agreements and hold external partners accountable for cost, performance, implementation, and knowledge transfer.

·  Evaluate build, buy and partner decisions based on long-term business requirements.


Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be an experienced, business-minded technology executive who combines broad IT leadership with the ability to understand how a complex operating business actually works.


This individual will have led meaningful enterprise technology transformation and be equally comfortable working with executive leadership, functional operators, and technical teams. They should bring sound judgment across enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, cloud environments, and end-user technology, while understanding how those capabilities connect to business performance.


A major priority will be evaluating TNT's future ERP direction. The VP will assess the current JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environment objectively—determining whether the right path is to optimize and extend the existing platform or transition to a new ERP—and then lead the organization through execution of that strategy. Direct JDE experience is valuable, but the more important requirement is having personally led a significant ERP evaluation, modernization, or implementation.


The VP will also be expected to shape TNT's enterprise AI strategy and move the organization from exploration to practical adoption. This includes identifying high-value use cases, ensuring the data and integration environment can support them, establishing appropriate governance and security, and measuring whether AI initiatives produce meaningful business outcomes.


The VP will have executive responsibility for cybersecurity, infrastructure, enterprise applications, data and reporting, technology vendors, end-user support, and business continuity. This person must understand the fundamentals—the technology that needs to work reliably every day—while also identifying opportunities to modernize the environment and introduce emerging capabilities where they create measurable business value.


TNT's highly seasonal operating model adds another dimension to the role. The technology environment must scale rapidly to support geographically distributed retail and operating locations during critical revenue periods. The successful candidate will understand how to balance transformation with reliability, security, and operational continuity.


Required Experience

·  10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including meaningful experience leading through managers.

·  Demonstrated ownership of a significant ERP evaluation, modernization, migration, or implementation.

·  Experience leading enterprise technology transformation in a complex operating environment.

·  Broad leadership experience across enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud, data, cybersecurity and end-user technology.

·  Demonstrated experience evaluating, implementing, or scaling AI and emerging technology initiatives within an enterprise environment, with an emphasis on practical business value, governance, and adoption.

·  Executive-level responsibility for cybersecurity, technology risk, incident preparedness, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

·  Working knowledge of recognized security frameworks and controls, including PCI-DSS in a payment environment.

·  Experience supporting multi-site operations such as retail, distribution, manufacturing, consumer products or similarly complex businesses.

·  Proven ability to partner across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions.

·  Experience managing major technology vendors, consultants and systems integrators.

·  Demonstrated ability to translate technology strategy and investment into measurable business and operational outcomes.

·  Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

·  Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent professional experience.


Preferred Experience

·  Direct JD Edwards EnterpriseOne experience, including familiarity with CNC concepts.

·  Technology leadership within retail, distribution, consumer products, or manufacturing.

·  Experience supporting geographically distributed and highly seasonal operations.

·  Experience establishing AI enablement, governance, data classification, or enterprise productivity programs.

·  Experience with POS, EDI, payment systems, logistics technology or similarly integrated operational technology environments.

·  Cloud migration or modernization experience involving core business systems.

·  Experience leading an organization through a cybersecurity incident, audit, or assessment and subsequent remediation.

·  Experience operating within a privately held or entrepreneurial organization undergoing transformation.

·  MBA or relevant technology/security certifications.


Leadership Profile

The right executive will be a business-minded technology operator rather than a technology specialist operating in isolation.


They will understand both sides of the mandate: the transformational work that moves TNT forward—including ERP modernization, AI adoption, and broader digital enablement—and the foundational technology that simply has to work every time the business needs it.


They will be comfortable challenging assumptions and determining whether a business problem requires new technology, better utilization of existing technology, the application of AI or automation, or a change in the underlying process. They will bring enough technical depth to ask the right questions and make sound decisions without feeling the need to personally perform the work their managers and technical teams are responsible for.


This executive will lead through others, develop the three managers currently responsible for key areas of the technology organization, and build greater depth and alignment across applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and enterprise systems.


Most importantly, this person will have the judgment to determine what TNT needs next, establish executive alignment around that direction, and lead the organization through implementation without compromising the reliability, security, and continuity of the existing business.

Translate strategy into an executable plan.

Take annual goals and segment strategy and build the marketing plan for your audience: objectives, message platform, campaign calendar, channel mix, budget and success metrics. Bring it forward, defend it, and revise it quarterly against performance.

Email, website content, SEO, organic social and nurture are your core channels. You own the calendar, the copy, the audience segmentation, the testing plan and the results.

Write the creative brief.

Produce briefs clear enough that internal designers, writers and outside agencies can execute without a second meeting. Review work against the brief. Send it back when it misses.

Direct paid, don’t execute it.

Define the audience, objective, offer, message and asset requirements for paid campaigns. Review performance with our agency and make the recommendation on where the next dollar goes.

Measure and adjust.

Build and track your campaigns in HubSpot, report results in plain language and change the plan when the data says to.

Work across the organization.

Partner with Product, Content, Publications, Education, Corporate Services and Membership. Much of this job is earning alignment from people who do not report to you.

  • Proven cross-functional influence without formal authority.

  • Familiarity with procurement, supply chain, or a comparable professional community.
  • Association or mission-driven organization experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field.

The organization has served its professional community for more than 110 years. It is a not-for-profit whose mission is to connect and empower the global professional community to advance individual and organizational success.

The organization operates on a hybrid model and currently requires employees to work in the office on Thursdays. The marketing team is small, which means your work is visible, your decisions are yours, and there is very little distance between an idea and its launch.

  • Retirement planning

The position offers a base salary of approximately $80,000, with some flexibility depending on experience, plus performance-based commission. Depending on production and product mix, successful advisors can have the opportunity to earn well into six figures.

You are not being asked to start with an empty book.

You will have access to an established agency, a strong local reputation, an experienced team, and approximately 10,000 existing households where investment, retirement, insurance, and asset-consolidation opportunities already exist.

The opportunity is ideal for someone who wants the upside of a producer role while having a substantial existing client base to work from.

The Nurse Practitioner (NP) brings expert care to members, through clinical assessments, screenings, and education. This role may provide care in a variety of settings including member/participant homes, assisted living facilities, and skilled nursing facilities.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Perform screenings including medical history, physical exam, medication reconciliation and education.
  • Effectively identify, evaluate, and address the concerns of the member, employee or participant.
  • Order and interpret diagnostic imaging, laboratory results and provide clinically appropriate interventions, additional tests, or referral as needed.
  • Administer and order point of care and lab based testing
  • Refer members to PCP, case management, disease management programs, and/or appropriate specialist as necessary.
  • Work collaboratively with a variety of stakeholders including risk & quality teams, staffing, operations, physicians, case managers, social workers, care givers and ancillary medical personnel.
  • Participate in all mandatory compliance and other training programs, seek guidance for compliance related concerns and adhere to all applicable laws, regulations and Matrix policies and procedures.

  • Master’s Degree required OR commensurate experience and satisfactory completion of NP licensure.
  • Current RN and NP licensure in state of practice to include prescription authority or the ability to obtain prescriptive authority.

job.description:
Director of Operations- Airframe

What you’ll do:

  • Plans and directs aircraft and avionics maintenance, installation, and shop activities and coordinates with other departments to assure high quality work and timely delivery to our customers. Maintains a safe work environment; ensures that stringent housekeeping, 5S standards and safety procedures and practices are followed; ensures that tools/equipment meet safety requirements; leads trend and root cause analysis and accident investigations. Maintains positive employee relations by providing an inclusive work environment
  • Will manage a team of 70 technicians and managers.
  • Attains P&L objectives by monitoring work-in-process to assure that work is accomplished within allotted hours and within cost of sales parameters.
  • Responsible for all Hangar Line Maintenance functions, as well as the Electrical Shop, Avionics Shop, and Sheet Metal Shop.
  • Reviews contract pricing to ensure that competitiveness, profitability, customer satisfaction, and market growth are maintained.
  • Closely monitors sales forecast and WIP and works with the sales team to ensure plan targets are met.
  • Reviews and corrects invoices for work performed in areas of his/her control to ensure the accuracy of the work description, hours charged, and parts issued.
  • Coordinates and reviews the preparation of all work estimates (quotes) to ensure a prompt response to our customers.
  • This position is a point of contact for technical questions from customers and for status of work-in-progress.
  • Ensures that all employees receive appropriate technical training and on-the-job instruction to maintain the highest standards of quality.
  • Promotes, encourages and leads employees towards a continuous improvement culture. Leads the implementation of Lean initiatives.
  • Coordinates and liaises with quality assurance, engineering, material, customer service, sales, finance, etc. to resolve difficult or continuing problems and ensure production standards and goals are achieved.
  • Monitors and analyzes output, cycle times, routings, labor, quality, staffing, facility usage, budget, financial performance, etc. for all cells/service operations and oversees and participates in the resolution of problems or reinforcement of positive findings.
  • Conducts regular capacity planning of equipment, floor space and labor resources required based on forecast demands.
  • Formulates, recommends and implements policies and programs to guide the corporation in maintaining and improving the competitive position and profitability of the operation.
  • Actively participates in the appropriate management team(s), assisting with the development and realization of strategic plans, budgets, goals and outcomes.
  • Ensures that all employees receive safety training and consistently employ safe work practices. Enforces quality standards; monitors and provides corrective action for workmanship issues.
  • Responsible for ensuring positive employee relations by dealing with issues in a fair, equitable, and consistent manner.
  • Exercises authority in hiring, training, career development, performance appraisal, salary adjustments, promotion, discipline, health, safety and the general employee relations of direct reports.

What skills you will use:     

  • Bachelor’s Degree or related field and/or equivalent experience.
  • FAA Airframe and Power plant license and minimum of 5 years recent experience in in an Operational leadership role with delivered and sustainable results.
  • P&L experience required. 
  • Strong business acumen and innate curiosity with a talent for finding and maximizing opportunities in order to collaborate and contribute to the success of the total business model.
  • Proven record of change management, operational excellence and continuous improvement achievements. 
  • Demonstrated inspirational leadership experience with core values centered on a participative communication style with a high degree of transparency and empathy; must naturally lead by example through physical presence, employee engagement and communication with all levels of the organization effectively.
  • Ability to lead effectively under tight deadlines and high stress situations with a steadfast commitment to prioritizing safety, quality and scheduling.
  • Strong customer service aptitude and skilled in balancing customer demands with business unit priorities.
  • Ability to analyze and troubleshoot technical problems.
  • Must have planning, scheduling, and labor resource allocation skills with the ability to handle multiple projects and multiple deadlines.
  • Possesses financial acumen, strong organizational, analytical, strategic planning, and decision-making and problem-solving skills while demonstrating situational awareness. 
  • Effective communicator, both oral and written. Must possess excellent interpersonal customer and employee relations skills.
  • Sit, stand, and/or walk for extended periods of time.
  • Bend and climb in order to look at various parts of the aircraft.
  • Manipulate a telephone, calculator, and computer keyboard.
  • Speak audibly and intelligibly over the telephone and in person.
  • See and read technical information and invoices.
  • Work well in a demanding, stressful, fast-paced environment.
  • Travel Requirement up 15%.
